prompts.title: Yûsuf'un kuyudan çıkarılması
prompts.prompt:
Cinematic historical visualization inspired by the Quranic story of Prophet Joseph
being discovered in a well.

Ancient Near Eastern desert landscape, deep stone well, several travelers discovering
a young person inside the well, wooden rope and leather water container, dusty caravan
route, historically plausible ancient clothing and equipment.

Warm early morning light, cinematic depth, realistic environment,
archaeological documentary atmosphere.

Do not show Prophet Joseph's identifiable face. Use distant framing or rear view.
